page.layout: One printed page, single column. Running head centred above the text. Title block (dedication) centred, with a decorative fleuron above it. Below it the preface title, then a paragraph opened by a woodcut initial. Catchword at the lower right below the rule. Signature and page number at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Ad Nobili prudentiâ amp!lissimum Virum Dominum BERNHARDVM à GEISMAR REIPUB. WARBURGENSIS Consulem dignissimum, Dominum ac amicum obseruandum
OTHONIS CASMANNI PRÆFATIO.

p.i: Rnamentum[?] ac decus insigne Warburgensium Reipub. Nobili prudentiâ amplissime Vir, Domine & Amice honorande, semper duxi & depradicavi GEISMARIORUM nobilem & de ipsa præclarè promeritam gentem. Quantâ, me Christe, autoritate, quæ Magistratus est apex, quantâ fide, quamq; felici dexteritate, longo eam tempore administrarit: Magnus ille

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorated O-frame; the letter inside reads as R, so the joined word "Rnamentum" is marked [?]. The dedication line reads "amp!lissimum" as printed, with the stray "!" left in place (printing error). Long s has been normalised to s. The catchword "omni-" sits below the rule at the right.
